the upstream response returns to the caller verbatim: body bytes unchanged, Content-Type preserved, and the STATUS forwarded as-is INCLUDING non-2xx — a stub 400 (error body) comes back as 400 with that exact body; the router never rewrites an upstream status or wraps an upstream body in its own envelope (G5, plan 90-92: the router never returns a status the direct path would not have returned)

a request to a path outside /v1/* and outside the reserved /conductor/* prefix (e.g. GET /foo, POST /api/x) is answered 404 BY THE ROUTER and the stub upstream observes ZERO requests for it; the test deliberately does NOT pin /conductor/* behavior (reserved for Task 11.7 per the pinned gap resolution)
